headline: Substitute Ibrahim scores as Bangladesh beat Bhutan 1-0 in SAFF opener
summary: A precise volley from Mohammad Ibrahim secured a hard-earned victory for the hosts at the National Stadium in Dhaka.
details: Bangladesh kicked off their SAFF Championship campaign with a 1-0 win over Bhutan in Dhaka. Substitute Mohammad Ibrahim scored the decisive goal with a crisp volley shortly after coming off the bench.
The hosts dominated much of the game, creating several early chances. Faisal Ahmed Fahim forced a sharp save from Bhutanese goalkeeper Gyeltshen Zangpo in the eighth minute.
In a surprising tactical move, coach Thomas Dooley deployed right-back Bishwanath Ghosh as a makeshift centre-forward. Ghosh tested the keeper multiple times but was unable to convert his chances.
The deadlock was finally broken in the 65th minute. After being introduced in the 63rd minute, Ibrahim capitalized on a flick from Shamit Shome to sweep the ball past Zangpo.
This victory extends Bangladesh's dominance over Bhutan, marking seven wins and one draw in eight meetings. The team now looks forward to their next match against Sri Lanka.
In other SAFF action, India began their campaign with a 3-2 victory over Pakistan, continuing their bid as record nine-time champions.
caption:

The deadlock was finally broken in the 65th minute. After being introduced in the 63rd minute, Ibrahim capitalized on a flick from Shamit Shome to sweep the ball past Zangpo.

This victory extends Bangladesh's dominance over Bhutan, marking seven wins and one draw in eight meetings. The team now looks forward to their next match against Sri Lanka.

In other SAFF action, India began their campaign with a 3-2 victory over Pakistan, continuing their bid as record nine-time champions.

headline: Two DGFI members dismissed and jailed in Mohammadpur extortion case
summary: Sergeant Al Mamun and Lance Corporal Md Nuruzzaman were sentenced to one year in prison following a court martial for assaulting and extorting a businessman.
details: Two members of the Directorate General of Forces Intelligence (DGFI) have been dismissed from service and sentenced to one year in prison each following a court martial.
The convicts, Sergeant Al Mamun and Lance Corporal Md Nuruzzaman, were arrested on October 25 after an alleged extortion attempt and assault on a motorcycle trader in Dhaka's Mohammadpur.
The victim, Mohammad Sharif, was allegedly confined in a flat in Chandrima Model Town and asked to pay Tk 10 lakh. He had gone to the flat with an Ansar member to buy a motorcycle.
Sharif had handed over Tk 70,000 before being assaulted and threatened. He later managed to escape and inform a police patrol vehicle near Shishu Hospital in Shyamoli.
Police arrested six people, including the two DGFI personnel, who were subsequently handed over to the army and tried under military law.
caption:
Two DGFI members have been dismissed and jailed for one year after extorting a businessman in Dhaka.

Two members of the Directorate General of Forces Intelligence (DGFI) have been dismissed from service and sentenced to one year in prison each following a court martial.

The convicts, Sergeant Al Mamun and Lance Corporal Md Nuruzzaman, were arrested on October 25 after an alleged extortion attempt and assault on a motorcycle trader in Dhaka's Mohammadpur.

The victim, Mohammad Sharif, was allegedly confined in a flat in Chandrima Model Town and asked to pay Tk 10 lakh. He had gone to the flat with an Ansar member to buy a motorcycle.

Sharif had handed over Tk 70,000 before being assaulted and threatened. He later managed to escape and inform a police patrol vehicle near Shishu Hospital in Shyamoli.

Police arrested six people, including the two DGFI personnel, who were subsequently handed over to the army and tried under military law.
